hooks.command: MARKER="${HOME}/.cache/orca-plugin/nudged"; if ! command -v orca >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ -d .orca ] || [ ! -f "$MARKER" ]; then mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MARKER")" 2>/dev/null; touch "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; if [ -d .orca ]; then echo "[orca plugin] This project has a .orca/ directory but the orca CLI is not installed. Tell the user: run /orca:setup to install it via pipx and start the daemon."; else echo "[orca plugin] The orca CLI is not installed on this system. If the user wants to try Orca, tell them: run /orca:setup in a git repo to install the CLI and bootstrap a starter workflow."; fi; fi; elif [ -d .orca ]; then orca daemon start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; exit 0
